ana: Quick brain-dump: we need a compact operator playbook for deliberate degradation of dedicated GPU pools. Postmortem showed on-call uncertainty and risky manual fixes.

fernando: Yep. The sequence we saw: sudden tenant spike -> prewarm credits depleted -> eviction churn -> scale attempts hit MIG fragmentation -> longer recovery.

claire: I'm thinking a deterministic 3-phase procedure so humans and automation behave the same: stabilize -> prioritize -> spill.

ana: typo :)

ana (ana): Stabilize = runtime soft-tweaks (reduce batch multiplier, disable async prefetch, prefer single-worker inference). Prioritize = tighten admission to SLA tiers + enable soft-preemptible lanes. Spill = route a controlled fraction to hosted/quantized variants with per-tenant caps.

fernando: Need clear numeric triggers. Suggest rolling p95 > 1s AND prewarm_fail_rate > 4% for 25s. Exit when both metrics are healthy for 75s. Include 10-30s randomized delay before applying changes to avoid synchronized fallbacks.

yuki: Add an inhibit for scale-downs while any degradation stage active (2x hysteresis). Also an audit entry whenever a human forces a stage.

ops-bot: incident 2026-05-10-91 created by infra-bot  link: https://incidents.internal/2026-05-10-91 :rotating_light:

dave: Minimal policy sketch (YAML):
```yaml
policy_v1:
  triggers:
    p95_ms: 1000
    prewarm_fail_pct: 4
    window_s: 25
  exit_hysteresis_s: 75
  jitter_s: 20
  stages:
    - id: stabilize
      actions:
        batch_scale: 0.7
        disable_prefetch: true
        packing_reset: prefer_coalesce
    - id: prioritize
      actions:
        admission_allow: [sla_platinum, sla_gold]
        enable_preemptible: true
    - id: spill
      actions:
        route_pct_default: 0.08
        max_per_tenant: 0.2
        target_variant: hosted-quant8
```

claire: Operational notes: (1) route_pct should be tenant-aware via per-tenant token buckets; (2) make admission responses include degradation_tier tag for client telemetry; (3) add cost-estimate metadata for spill stage to surface in console.

ana: Action items: fernando writes concrete thresholds and sim windows; yuki implements scale-down inhibit and audit hook; claire adds admission tag + tenant buckets; dave adds cost fields and policy validation tests. I'll draft the runbook and short RFC follow-up and schedule a 30-min sync. Please ping when PRs land. :thumbsup:
